title: What Are We Measuring When We Evaluate Large Vision-Language Models? An Analysis of Latent Factors and Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing transfer learning performance across vision-language tasks partitioned by average output lengths (1-3 words, 6-12 words, >40 words) to demonstrate that a mismatch in output length between source and target tasks causes significant performance drops, acting as a shortcut feature.

Applying Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) to discover latent capability factors, revealing an artificial contrast between Generative and Multiple-Choice (MC) evaluations where strict exact-match requirements in generative tasks penalize models disproportionately compared to MC probability comparisons.
